notes.title: GUTS Update now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30526425/6bb01bb6efa4c71b5dbde30e232f2994f28ec109.jpg[/img]

The new update for [b]GUTS[/b] brings a multitude of improvements to the game that will not only enhance gameplay but also make the game more accessible for new players entering battle. Apart from enhanced graphics, the game receives a complete overhaul of the fighting system to allow for faster and more fluid action.
The main changes to the game are:
[list]
[*]Full rework of the move system, with rebalancing and streamlined controller input
[*]After losing a limb, the remaining body parts now allow for more powerful combos and moves, giving the player a chance for a big comeback
[*]All GUTS moves have been optimized and can be executed quicker and more fluidly, also every character now features two GUTS moves
[*]Players can now specifically select the limbs to target with their GUTS moves
[*]New blocking system; the blocks are easier to pull off and now feature an energy bar, that, if depleted, can lead to dizziness of the character
[*]New lighting, many new graphic effects, higher framerates and a more streamlined gameplay experience with optimized integration of bullet time lead to a more fluid gaming experience
[/list]

notes.title: Free New Content - GUTS Holiday!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30526425/8b84f1b633b23779c498899034d24e9f7ac68e8e.jpg[/img]

[H1]It’s that time of the year, and Santa has brought us a big free GUTS update!

NEW FEATURES[/H1]

[B]New Stage - Winter Lodge[/B]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30526425/a9d3242d4c794582557d106503a3ec739668c585.jpg[/img]
You asked for it, we heard: more stages! 

Winter Lodge is here with all those snowy fights, a deadly shark that eats your limbs out, snowmen that can be thrown into your rivals and that cool winter atmosphere.

[B]New Game Mode - Hazard Only[/B]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30526425/06472e821b56190600d1ab888483b4947a1aa692.jpg[/img]
No GUTS Moves allowed! No throwing limbs or objects! Only hazards to throw your rivals into. But hey, we redesigned all the levels to have LOTS of hazards and make this a very fun and quick party-like mode!

[B]New Game Mode - Hardcore Mode[/B]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30526425/cb5535ce17f9ddb4c2c30d9b2c1444625bfb5068.jpg[/img]
Are you good enough to face the Hardcore Mode? It’s the hardest way to finish GUTS’ stories!
You don’t get your limbs back after each fight!
No retries. You lose a match, it’s game over!

[B]All Game Modes available in Single Player[/B]
Now you can play all the alternate game modes against the AI too!

[B]Christmas Skins[/B]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30526425/64e7702700d228196013632b5f77018fc09c3e4f.jpg[/img]
All characters have a new Christmas Skin with hoodies and Christmas colors. Check them out and unlock them in the Extras area!

[B]New Menu[/B]
Main menu has been redesigned to make navigation better and more intuitive

[B]Random Select[/B]
You can now pick a random character and a random stage

[B]Skins Online[/B]
Now you can select your favorite skin to play online


[H1]BALANCING[/H1]

[B]U-Point Gain[/B]
Every character now gets 2 u-points when losing a limb

[B]Standardized Knockback[/B]
Every character flyes the same distance in both X and Y axis when they are hit by a hard knockback attack

[B]Movement and Jump[/B]
Characters have new weight, jump height and air movement speed

[B]1-Hit Mode[/B]
This mode no longer has infinite U-Points

[B]Full Chaos[/B]
It takes more time to fill up U-Points in this game mode

[H1]FIXES[/H1]

[B]General[/B]
Fixed the current resolution information in the options menu

[H1]HAPPY HOLIDAYS <3[/H1]

[B]<<QUICK FIXES Patch Notes 1.0.5>>[/B]
Fixed loading save file problems;

notes.title: GUTS Special Moves - Svet Stepanova
notes.content:

[h1]SVET STEPANOVA SPECIAL MOVES!![/h1]

How about chopping limbs Rock´n Roll style? Check Out Svet Stepanova moves!

[b]- Left Kick[/b]
Rock Stance: hop on your wheel-leg and prepare for four different awesome attacks. When in this stance, press the buttons to perform the follow-up attack!
Rock Stance Left Kick - Slide it In: dive in a low stance to send them upwards
Rock Stance Right Kick - Unforgiven: kick them hard with huge horizontal knockback
Rock Stance Right Punch - Wonderwall: dive forward with your bass-blade for multihit bar building
Rock Stance Left Punch - September Rain: Multihit uppercut that sends foes up high

[b]- Right Kick[/b]
Knee'vil: Dive forward and launch opponents into the air
Power Stomp: Kick them when they are down! Good bounce vertical knockback

[b]- Left Punch[/b]
Power Slide: Slide forward in a low stance to start combos
Fuck You I Won't do what you tell me: Fill your GUTS bar by misbehaving (Passive)

[b]- Right Punch[/b]
The Kuuuurt! - Launch a low and slow powerful projectile
Power Chord: Extreme horizontal knockback with this shotgun-like move

Are you ready to crush enemies with an attitude?

notes.title: GUTS UNIVERSE - VIOLENCE
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30526425/8e4e5a3532dfa9293a141ead9cc25fbdf10dc0ca.png[/img]

The GUTS show is the prime representation of society. A spectacle which unites advertising, violence, sports, fame, technology, and creativity. All in favor of deciding who will the world’s next idol.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30526425/b100272159c34cacc3de4149e3ac29d92722702f.png[/img]

[h1]Violence[/h1]
In the world of GUTS, physical violence is somewhat peculiar. On one hand it is an accepted spectacle which generates billions of revenue, yet on the streets it has become significantly absent. Though people still get into frequent arguments and fights, society has transferred its willingness to punch each other in the face into the habit of swearing, screaming, and trolling on the social networks. In large part, this has happened because economic contrasts have diminished among individuals, but obsessions with fame and popularity have risen.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30526425/350d6e49d1ae83bae92460e9df9e3c36235eb0f5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Violence on TV[/h1]
Violence has become a spectacle. The rule of the world of GUTS is that anything is allowed as long as you’ve got a signed contract and the promise of fame. This is what drives TV and why violence is so relevant. The crimes and rage people no longer commit on the streets have become the nature of TV shows.

All of them act as convenient escapism and offer gore to spectators in a secure and captivating manner. Absurdity is the standard because individuals are literally willing to die for fame, while others are more than happy to watch because they secretly desire the same thing, yet are too afraid to participate.

The world has ceased to be (physically) savage and dangerous, therefore the preposterous premises of having people hitting, kicking, and killing each other satiates the human being’s thirst for chaos.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30526425/7af6c14ee873039897414c7a139a4643b97240cb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Low Crime Rates[/h1]
Thanks to a series of economical changes, monetary contrast has largely dissipated among members of society. All individuals are entitled to a governmental allowance which provides for one’s basic needs. Despite not having eliminated greed - luxuries are still existent -, petty thefts and most money driven crimes have become rare occasions.

Homicides and other offenses against the law are usually of emotional origin, not for financial gain. Very few extend to physical violence and even digital felonies, such as hacking accounts, are not many because the fame industry has heavily invested in security measures.

notes.title: GUTS GAME MODES
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30526425/05aba04b1214f6897784ba771f7de7dfeb8d50eb.png[/img]

Guts has a wide variety of game modes to enjoy, some of them are classic modes such as local multiplayer, others are special modes that take advantage of GUTS gameplay innovations, like Full Chaos Mode or 1-Hit Dismember Mode.

[list]
[*]Story Mode: Play through GUTS Characters’ Stories against the AI - Can you discover both the 2  different endings per character?
[*]Local Versus Mode: Play against your friends locally for some couch carnage!
[*]Online Mode: Play casually or competitively against other players in the world and see how you rank up
[*]Full Chaos Mode*: GUTS BARS ARE FULL and you have Unlimited U-Points - this provides some insane over the top frantic dismemberment gameplay! 
[*]1-Hit Dismember Mode*: Every hit dismembers, watch yourself!
[*]Tutorial Mode: Play tutorials to master GUTS’ Mechanics
[*]Free Training: Practice freely
[/list]

Choose your favorite Game Mode and slaughter your opponents with no mercy!


* Stay tuned and check our updates for more details on these crazy game modes
